name: sdlc
description: Marketplace for the sdlc plugin: an orchestrated, gated software lifecycle for Claude Code.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: One Claude Code plugin for the whole software lifecycle: an orchestrator sizes each piece of work (trivial, S, M or L) and walks it through four phases (define, build, review, ship), leaving one record with the code (a change file for people, a state file for the agent): test-first builds that prove each acceptance criterion with one verify command, reviews recommended from the diff after the build (security only where security is touched), then ship and learn, plus guardrail hooks, design-system-aware UI review and setup/upgrade for any stack or monorepo.

plugins.name: sdlc-extras
plugins.description: Optional companions to the sdlc plugin: the Ralph loop (/sdlc-extras:ralph-loop), hookify's list, configure and help commands, and the conversation-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, comment-analyzer and code-simplifier agents that /sdlc:hookify and /sdlc:review-pr use when present.
